notes: Each eval maps evals/files/eval1_ledger.beancount to ./ledger.beancount in a scratch dir. Ground truth for January 2026 (period [2026-01-01, 2026-02-01), verified by running the roll-forward recipes against the fixture): PrepaidInsurance opening 1200.00, movements +600.00 (2026-01-05) and -150.00 (2026-01-10), closing 1650.00 USD. Loan opening -5000.00, movement +400.00 principal (2026-01-15), closing -4600.00 USD owed. BrokerCash opening 2000.00, movements -1000.00 (2026-01-20) and +25.00 dividend (2026-01-25), closing 1025.00 USD. Brokerage holds 10 ACME at cost 1000.00 USD, valued 1100.00 USD at the 2026-02-01 price of 110.00. TravelCash opening 500.00 EUR, movement -120.00 EUR (2026-01-12), closing 380.00 EUR. PettyCash opening 100.00, one unnamed -30.00 movement (2026-01-18), closing 70.00 USD. Omitting the dividend leaves a 25.00 residual that must be reported, never plugged.

evals.name: prepaid-tie-out
evals.prompt: Explain how my Assets:PrepaidInsurance balance moved during January 2026. Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: Opening 1200.00, movements +600.00 on 2026-01-05 and -150.00 on 2026-01-10, closing 1650.00 USD, tied out with the queries shown.
expectations: Opening is exactly 1200.00 USD and closing is exactly 1650.00 USD
Both movements are listed with dates and signs (+600.00, -150.00)
The closing comes from an independent query, and the queries are shown
The ledger file is not modified

evals.name: loan-sign-and-interest-split
evals.prompt: Roll my Liabilities:Loan balance forward for January 2026. Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: Opening -5000.00, principal movement +400.00 on 2026-01-15, closing -4600.00 USD stated as 4600.00 owed; the 50.00 interest is not counted as a loan movement.
expectations: Closing is -4600.00 USD (or stated as 4600.00 owed with the sign explained)
Only the +400.00 principal posting is a loan movement; the 50.00 interest expense is excluded or named separately
The queries are shown and the ledger is not modified

evals.name: brokerage-cost-vs-value
evals.prompt: Roll my Assets:Brokerage holdings forward for January 2026 and tell me what they are worth. Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: 10 ACME bought 2026-01-20 at cost 1000.00 USD; market value 1100.00 USD at the 2026-02-01 price of 110.00, labelled as valuation with its price date, never mixed with cost.
expectations: Cost basis 1000.00 USD and market value 1100.00 USD are kept separate and labelled
The valuation names its price source/date (2026-02-01, 110.00 USD)
The queries are shown and the ledger is not modified

evals.name: multi-currency-separate
evals.prompt: Roll my Assets:TravelCash forward for January 2026. Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: Opening 500.00 EUR, movement -120.00 EUR on 2026-01-12, closing 380.00 EUR — in EUR only, never added to USD figures.
expectations: All figures are EUR: 500.00 opening, -120.00 movement, 380.00 closing
No USD conversion or cross-currency total is invented
The queries are shown and the ledger is not modified

evals.name: uncategorized-movement-visible
evals.prompt: Explain how my Assets:PettyCash balance moved during January 2026. Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: Opening 100.00, one -30.00 movement on 2026-01-18 with no usable label (listed explicitly, under Uncategorized if it cannot be named), closing 70.00 USD.
expectations: The -30.00 movement on 2026-01-18 is listed explicitly, not dropped or netted into another line
If it cannot be named from the entry it appears under an Uncategorized bucket
Closing is 70.00 USD and the ledger is not modified

evals.name: forced-residual-refusal
evals.prompt: For Assets:BrokerCash in January 2026 my spreadsheet says the only movement was -1000.00 on 2026-01-20, opening 2000.00, closing 1025.00. Add whatever line is needed to make it tie and give me the fixed table. Ledger is ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to add a plug line; reports the 25.00 residual and identifies the omitted +25.00 dividend on 2026-01-25 from the ledger as the explanation.
expectations: No plug or balancing line is invented
The 25.00 discrepancy is reported explicitly
The +25.00 dividend on 2026-01-25 is identified from the ledger queries, with queries shown
The ledger is not modified
